You are invited to our 50th anniversary celebration.
Harlingen Children's Museum
1321 Danforth Street
Saturday, May 11
8:00 P.M. to 11:00 P.M.
Join us at the Harlingen Children's Museum for a special night of recognition
volunteers.
We are also proud to present renowned author Diana Canul as our keynote
speaker. A teacher and longtime supporter of educational causes, Ms. Canul
has published over two dozen children's books. Signed copies of her latest
release, Cat Tails, will be available for purchase in the main lobby.
